caption: The drawing is done in grayscale pencil and depicts two views of a piece of outerwear, likely a shawl or mantle, worn over a long, full skirt. The main, larger figure shows the front view, featuring a fur-trimmed shawl with elaborate patterns and decorative elements, including tassels and floral designs at the neckline. The shawl drapes over the shoulders and extends down the front in two broad panels edged with fur or textured trim. The fabric appears richly detailed with repeated patterns and textures indicating embroidery or embellishments. Underneath, the lower outline of a simple, unadorned, and bell-shaped skirt is visible, sketched with faint lines. To the upper right, there is a smaller, secondary sketch of the same garment viewed from the back, showing the patterned shawl extending around the shoulders and upper back, with the plain skirt below. The background is plain, and the entire composition is monochromatic, with the focus on detailed shading and line work to display the texture and decorative features of the garment.
title: Wrap
